key_burial.name: Glasshouse Key
key_burial.description: Kept on a hook by the beds. The gardener locked up every night and nobody could say who for.

key_stone.name: The Company's Key
key_stone.description: Stamped G.M.Co. The tag is in the foreman's hand: THE STONE ON THE GRAVEYARD FOOTPATH. HIS, NOT OURS.

the_ball.name: The Ball
the_ball.description: The county's gold, cast into one sphere the size of a fist. It is warm, and it was in his hands.
